site.title: Hazel & Birch · Wedding Planning
site.description: Boutique wedding planning and design for couples getting married in Asheville and the wider Blue Ridge. We take eight weddings a year. We are usually full a year out.
site.author: Hazel Linwood
site.tagline: A wedding that feels like the two of you, not a venue brochure.

props.text: Asheville · Blue Ridge · Eight weddings a year
Maya kicked off her shoes at the overlook before the vows. We let her.

We plan and design weddings in Asheville and the surrounding Blue Ridge — venues you've heard of, dirt roads you haven't, and the in-between. Eight couples a year, every one of them designed around the moment that's actually theirs. Not the moment a venue brochure thinks should be theirs.
What this is, with no Pinterest board promises.

I'm Hazel Linwood. I started Hazel & Birch in 2018 after seven years at a larger Asheville planning firm where I was responsible, mostly, for keeping the timeline alive. We were good at that. We were less good at noticing the couple in the room. Birch is my partner Sam Cordell, who runs design and floral. We are two people. We do not subcontract.

We take eight weddings a year. The reason is selfish — we want to know your dog's name, where you got engaged, and which of your parents is going to cry first. By month four we usually do. We work with venues from the Omni Grove Park Inn down to a hand-built cabin in Madison County that fits forty-two guests if everyone is friendly. We design the day around what's true about you, then we run the day so you don't have to think about it.

We do not do same-day install. We do not do thirty-six-hour buildouts. We do not promise a wedding that will go viral. We promise a wedding that the two of you will recognize when you walk into it, and a planner whose phone you will still have the day after.

props.quote: Hazel asked us, on call number two, what our dog Beans does when we both come home at the same time. She put that in the ceremony — not the dog, the feeling. I cried at my own rehearsal. My mother is still bringing it up.
props.author: Maya & Jordan Whitaker

props.quote: We had a guest list of 42 and a budget that scared us. Hazel and Sam never once made us feel small. They built a day inside our actual numbers and the cabin is now a real place we go back to in our heads.
props.author: Elena & Pat Mendez-Riley

props.quote: Our wedding had 180 people, three hotel blocks, and one mother-of-the-bride who is a force of nature. Hazel ran point on all of it without ever making me feel handled. I have her contact still pinned. I just text her about lasagna now.
props.author: Serena & Amani Okonkwo-Reyes
props.role: Married May 24, 2025 · Omni Grove Park Inn

props.quote: I am a wedding photographer. I have shot eighty-something weddings. Hazel & Birch is the only planning team I have ever called the next day to thank, then called the next month to ask if they were taking referrals. They are.
props.author: Tessa Brand
